author: troy
content:
managed to crack these math constants here:```
JGeometry::TRotation3<TMtx33f> rot(dir, -(0.017453294f * (0.005493164f * (f32)mRollAccum)));
```
0.017453294f is pi / 180 aka DEG2RAD (degrees to radians)
0.005493164f is 360 / 65536 aka ANGLE2DEG (angle to degrees)

I feel like they had some macro combo for this like:
`-JMADeg2Rad(JMAAngle2Deg(mRollAccum))`
which converts into 
`-(0.017453294f * (0.005493164f * (f32)mRollAccum))`

content: What’s the process of naming

author: Mrkol
content: When decompiling code either manually or using an LLM, it is very convenient to leave various things with dumb names like `unk3FC` where 0x3FC is the thing's offset in memory. After the thing is decompiled enough, those offsets are no longer useful and we want to actually understand what the code does so we rename things to have proper names like `mFartTimer`
